races.verdict: LIBERTANGO had recent Phoenix Stakes winner Sun Goddess behind in second when landing the Albany at Royal Ascot so that form looks strong and she's taken to make amends for a short-priced reversal at Newmarket. Owner Jaber Abdullah has won this race 5 times (also had the second last year) and his wide-margin Leopardstown maiden scorer Star of State is feared most ahead of Wild Blossom , whose yard has won this twice since 2019, and Ruby Moon , who was 2 lengths behind the selection at Newmarket. LIBERTANGO (IRE) STAR OF STATE (IRE) WILD BLOSSOM (IRE)

races.verdict: SUN GODDESS could have been handed a more beneficial draw but Aidan O'Brien's Phoenix Stakes heroine is a clear standout on form and should still prove capable of landing this valuable prize. Satellite of Love can go close in his bid to provide Clive Cox with a fourth consecutive win in this race, while top-weight Tokaido is also highly respected after a pair of Group wins in France. races.verdict: Preference is for CENTIGRADE , who beat a couple of now smart types on his second start at 2 yrs and returned from a lengthy absence with an impressive victory at Southwell. He gets the vote on handicap debut ahead of last year's winner of the race Bullet Point , while Hawksbill shaped well at Glorious Goodwood and is another to consider, along with The Lost King . races.verdict: FAOLADH may have got off lightly with a 3 lb rise for Galway given that the second has gone in since. Last year's winner Altimara took a step back in the right direction when fifth at Naas last time and could be primed for another bold bid in this race. La La Lucrative , who wasn't far behind the selection at Galway, Bear Right and low-mileage 3-y-o Mr Perth are a few of many others who could have a say in this competitive handicap. FAOLADH (IRE) ALTIMARA (IRE) BEAR RIGHT (IRE)

races.verdict: GINO BELLA is on an upward curve, having won her last two starts at Cork under positive rides, and she is taken to shrug off another rise and complete the hat-trick in a race lacking confirmed front runners. Autumn Twist is a C&D winner who chased home subsequent Galway Hurdle winner Putapoundinthejar at Bellewstown when last seen in this sphere and rates the main danger if able to reproduce that form, while Fiveonefive did well to win at Galway last time and should be thereabouts. GINO BELLA (IRE) AUTUMN TWIST (IRE) FIVEONEFIVE (IRE)
